title: British Egg Wrap
description: A simple and delicious egg wrap with a British twist. Perfect for breakfast or lunch.

ingredients.name: Juicy Wrap
ingredients.notes: use a whole wheat or gluten-free wrap if necessary

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Crack the egg into the pan and scramble it until it's cooked through.
While the egg is cooking, warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds or in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 2-3 minutes.
Once the wrap is warm, place it on a flat surface and add the scrambled egg to one half of the wrap.
Add any additional toppings you like, such as cheese or vegetables.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the egg and toppings.
